name: help-presentation

steps.action: Help pages: every DOC-017 Help article fits three themes at 320, 720 and 1440 CSS pixels
steps.actual: On the in-app Help article pages (/help/<article>), not the formal reader, all 5 guides for this role drew without horizontal overflow in the light, dark and warm themes at 320, 720 and 1440 CSS pixels: document-versions, document-folders, document-previews, document-repository, archive-and-delete-documents. That is 45 combinations

steps.action: Help pages: every DOC-017 Help article fits at an emulated 200% zoom
steps.actual: Zoom was emulated, not operated: Playwright has no zoom menu, so 200% is expressed through CDP as a 640 by 450 CSS-pixel viewport at device pixel ratio 2, the layout Chromium produces for a 1280 by 900 window at its 200% setting. At that layout every in-app Help article fitted without horizontal overflow and kept its search box; body/title sizes were document-versions 14px/32px, document-folders 14px/32px, document-previews 14px/32px, document-repository 14px/32px, archive-and-delete-documents 14px/32px

steps.action: Help pages: an article and its outline open by keyboard once Help is open
steps.actual: Help was opened with one pointer click on the page's banner Help link. From there the run was keyboard only: 11 Tab presses reached the "Upload Documents and add Document Versions" link (outline-style solid) and Enter opened /help/document-versions with the H1 focused, then 30 Tab presses reached the "Upload a new Document" outline link and Enter moved focus onto that heading
